ms.text:
MP1
variable
valid variable which may affect h stated
MP2
apparatus
ruler/measuring tape and
additional apparatus to measure the independent variable (if not height of release or diameter of ball)
method
MP3
measure the independent variable and release the ball
MP4
measure h and repeat for a new value of independent variable
MP5
control variable
any significant variable appropriate to the independent variable
MP6
table
columns with units, for independent variable and dependent variable
MP7
conclusion
compare readings in the table to see if / how / whether a change in the variable produces a change in h
OR plot a (line) graph with axes specified
